name: Biometric Movement Log
query:
SELECT
  l.name AS "Movement Log:Link/Daily Employee Movement Log:180",
  l.employee AS "Employee:Link/Employee:140",
  l.employee_name AS "Employee Name::220",
  e.event_date AS "Date:Date:100",
  e.event_time AS "Event Time:Datetime:150",
  e.device_name AS "Device / Location::150",
  e.location AS "Location::140",
  e.employee_device_id AS "Device ID::100",
  e.direction AS "Movement::80",
  e.authentication_mode AS "Authentication::110",
  e.authentication_result AS "Result::80",
  e.card_no AS "Card No::100",
  e.employee_checkin AS "Employee Checkin:Link/Employee Checkin:170"
FROM `tabDaily Employee Movement Log` l
INNER JOIN `tabDaily Employee Movement Entry` e ON e.parent = l.name
ORDER BY e.event_time DESC
